metroids.name: Larva
metroids.flavor: A larva's physiology is mostly identical to an Infant's, however, its size has grown considerably.

metroids.name: Alpha
metroids.flavor: The Metroid is now visually akin to an arthropod, though its insect-like legs have not reached their full length and size, thus preventing their use for ground locomotion.

metroids.name: Gamma
metroids.flavor: This stage is an expansion to the prior form. The four legs have fully developed, allowing it to walk along the ground while still maintaining its ability to fly.

metroids.name: Zeta
metroids.flavor: The Metroid's body drastically transforms for a second time, and at this point shares many traits with that of a quadrupedal, theropod dinosaur.

metroids.name: Omega
metroids.effect: If no ship contributes strength during a Containment Check, this metroid automatically breaches
metroids.flavor: The final and most powerful form of a standard Metroid. Now standing in a bipedal posture, the Omega Metroid sacrifices the mobility of the previous stage for increased size and strength.

metroids.name: Hunter
metroids.effect: This metroid breaches before other stages. If it breaches, all characters you control get a Phazon token
